map.不一定。若基模型高度相关(同源训练)，融合增益很小甚至过拟合；只有误差多样、互补: Not necessarily. If the base models are highly correlated (trained from the same source), the ensemble gain is small or it may even overfit; only models with diverse, complementary errors improve reliably when ensembled.
map.加权平均概率 = Σpᵢwᵢ / Σwᵢ；硬投票 = Σ[pᵢ ≥ 0.5] ≥: Weighted average probability = Σpᵢwᵢ / Σwᵢ; hard voting = Σ[pᵢ ≥ 0.5] ≥ 2 predicts the positive class; ensemble confidence = |weighted probability − 0.5| × 2
map.加权平均直接对各模型输出概率做加权和，权重常按单模型验证准确率设定。: Weighted averaging forms a weighted sum of the output probabilities of the individual models, with weights usually set from each model's own validation accuracy.
map.加权投票：对各类别累加各模型输出概率×权重，取最大者为预测。: Weighted voting: accumulate each model's output probability × weight for every class and take the largest as the prediction.
map.常用各模型在验证集的准确率或 AUC 作权重，也可用网格搜索/线性规划优化组合系: Commonly use each model's validation accuracy or AUC as the weight; grid search or linear programming can also optimise the combination coefficients instead of setting them arbitrarily.
map.按各模型权重计算加权投票或加权平均的集成输出概率，适用于集成学习、模型融合与预测: Compute the ensemble output probability by weighted voting or weighted averaging using each model's weight, which applies to ensemble learning, model fusion and prediction-accuracy improvement scheme evaluation.

map.融合一定比单模型好吗？: Is Fusion Always Better Than a Single Model?
map.融合能降低方差、提升稳健性，前提是基模型具备多样性(误差不相关)。: Fusion reduces variance and improves robustness, provided the base models are diverse (uncorrelated errors).
map.软投票用权重平均概率，能利用模型输出的置信度信息，通常优于硬投票的多数决。权重可: Soft voting uses the weighted average probability, which can exploit the confidence information in the model outputs and is usually better than the majority vote of hard voting. The weights can be allocated by each model's validation performance; if the sub-models are too homogeneous (the same architecture with different seeds), the ensemble gain will be very limited.
map.：模型A对类别1概率0.7(权重0.6)，模型B 0.4(权重0.4) → 融合: : model A gives class 1 probability 0.7 (weight 0.6) and model B 0.4 (weight 0.4) → fusion=0.7×0.6+0.4×0.4=0.58, still class 1. If B had the higher weight (0.7), then 0.7×0.3+0.4×0.7=0.49 flips it to class 0.
